remarks:
Set just outside Jamestown, this 62.8-acre residential parcel offers a rare combination of serious infrastructure, future homesite potential, and genuinely strong recreational appeal. With a gated entrance, an established internal roadway system, and a substantial 100x60 pole barn already in place, the groundwork is here for someone looking to build while enjoying the land from day one.
Built around 2001, the pole barn features a 6-inch concrete floor, two 16-foot overhead doors, a loading dock, electric service, and gas heaters that are included with the sale but are not currently connected. A well and septic system, both approximately five years old, are already installed on-site and stubbed into the barn, offering added flexibility for future plans.
The land itself is predominantly wooded with a strong mix of habitat and mast-producing hardwoods, including an impressive number of mature shagbark oaks. Thick cover areas provide excellent bedding and wildlife habitat, while the established trail and roadway system allows truck access deep into the property. Whether your interest leans toward hunting, recreation, or simply enjoying a larger tract of land with privacy and utility, this property delivers a hard-to-find balance.
Residential zoning supports future homesite potential, and the gently rising terrain creates a natural sense of separation from the road while still maintaining convenient access to town. Located approximately five minutes from Jamestown and roughly three miles from I-86, this property offers a combination of accessibility and seclusion that is becoming increasingly difficult to find.
An existing gas well is present on the property. Seller is not receiving royalties and GMOs do not convey.
Do not enter the property without an agent.
